content.text: Which of the following list of actions is correct in order to put the yellow cube directly on top of the blue cube? Choices:  A. [remove green block, put yellow block on top of blue block]. B. [remove red block, remove green block, put yellow block on top of blue block]. C. [remove green block, remove red block, pick up yellow block]. D. [remove green block, remove red block, put yellow block on top of blue block]. Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
